name: Thunderforest
description: Thunderforest, the OpenStreetMap map maker, for the Thunderforest Map: the API key and the maps it keeps, shared by every task.

properties.name: apiKey
properties.title: API Key
properties.description: Your Thunderforest key. The free plan (a Hobby Project) is enough: sign up and the key is on your dashboard. Test asks Thunderforest whether it accepts the key.

properties.name: contentCacheHours
properties.title: Keep Maps (hours)
properties.description: The longest a map is kept and shared by every task before it is asked for again. A place and a zoom hardly change, and the free plan has a monthly quota, so a week is the default. The service's own headers can shorten this, never lengthen it. 0: ask every time.

properties.name: contentCacheMB
properties.title: Maps Pool Size (MB)
properties.description: The most disk the kept maps may use. When it is full, the one used longest ago goes first.

properties.name: staleDays
properties.title: Forget Unused Maps After (days)
properties.description: A kept map nobody has used for this many days is removed. 0: never.
